title: Home weather diary and written guide
subject: Geography
unit: Spring 2: Weather, climate and climate change
source: Written for geography/y8 lesson 9 (Home weather diary and written guide (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 9: Weather: what, why and where. Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

practical.aim: To record the weather every day for two weeks
equipment: Your rain gauge or a weather app
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: Choose the same time each day
Record temperature, rainfall, cloud and wind
Note the wind direction from a flag or trees
Plot temperature as a line graph

Big question: why is UK weather hard to predict?
questions.a: Different air masses, depressions from the Atlantic and our island position bring rapid changes
